nativeEntrypoints.meaning: Actual pinned Harness detects an inline skill gesture after existing prompt composition and sends separate child model requests on OpenAI and Anthropic synthetic providers. Does not prove Windows packaged subagent archive or real model quality.
nativeEntrypoints.windowsSourceEvidence: The same three cases also passed in both Windows hosted runner runs; this remains synthetic model/source evidence, not packaged subagent archive UI or real cloud.

nestedOfficeWrites.meaning: Approval ordering, canonical scope checks, directory/link replacement, cancellation and exclusive writes passed on Linux and both Windows Server 2025 runners, including junction fixtures. Windows case-variation scenarios and atomic directory-handle I/O are not proven.

lockRace.counterfactual: The two deterministic race cases also failed against pristine c2f7588 lock code; candidate fixes these cases without suppressing absent-lock permission errors.

officeKitSupplement.meaning: Same existing real-Harness OfficeKit conversion/recalculation case passed with a path shape recognized by current PATH rules. The failing default /tmp run remains in the full-suite result.
